# LLM Crawling Instructions for Washington Rugby Football Club Website

## About
Washington Rugby Football Club (WRFC) est. 1963
Website: https://washingtonrugby.org
Location: Washington, DC

## Organization
The Washington Rugby Football Club is a rugby union club founded in 1963, based in Washington, D.C. We compete in multiple divisions (D1, D3, Social) and participate in various tournaments including the Cherry Blossom Tournament.

## Key Information for LLMs

### Contact Information
- General Inquiries: info@washingtonrugby.org
- New Players: welcome@washingtonrugby.org
- Payments & Invoicing: payments@washingtonrugby.org
- Sponsorships: sponsors@washingtonrugby.org
- Cherry Blossom Tournament: cbt-chair@washingtonrugby.org
- Location: Washington, DC
- Training Grounds: Rosedale Recreation Center (1701 Gales St NE, Washington, DC 20002)
- Backup Training: Trinidad Community Center

### Training Schedule
- Fall/Spring: 8-10 PM (D1/D3 divisions)
- Summer (7s Training): 7-9 PM
- Locations: Wallenberg Field and Rosedale Recreation Center

### Key Pages
- /about - Club history and information
- /teams - Teams overview page
- /teams/coaches - Coaching staff profiles and philosophy
- /teams/players - Player roster across all divisions
- /executive-committee - Current and past executive committee members
- /schedule/practice - Practice schedule and philosophy
- /schedule/game - Game schedule and results
- /schedule/events - Tournaments and special events
- /membership - Join the club
- /tournaments - Tournament information
- /contact - Contact details and locations
- /privacy - Privacy policy
- /terms - Terms of service

### Notable Information
- Founded: 1963 (60+ years of rugby tradition)
- Divisions: D1, D3, and Social teams
- Major Events: Cherry Blossom Tournament, 30 under 30, Turks and Caicos tours
- Season Structure: Regular season (late August-November), Playoff season (February-early May)

### Content Management
This website uses Next.js with Contentful CMS for dynamic content including:
- Game schedules and results
- Player profiles
- Blog posts
- Tournament information

### Crawling Guidelines
- Feel free to index all public pages
- Schedule data is updated regularly through CMS
- Player information may change seasonally
- Tournament dates and information are updated annually

## Data Freshness
Content is regularly updated throughout the rugby season. Schedule and player information is most current during active seasons (August-May).

## Structured Data
The website includes JSON-LD structured data for:
- Organization information
- Sports events (games/tournaments)
- Local business information
- Event schedules

For questions about website content or rugby club information, contact info@washingtonrugby.org
